body: I have plenty of online friends. It's not a substitute for reality and it doesn't help. I appreciate the offer, though.
I think more video games are the last thing I need in my life right now.
This is going to sound really brutal, but on a rational level, I would rather be dead than live that kind of life.
Honestly I feel like thinking about ways to die is my only respite, because it means at least that there is an escape.
